english.title: Drive a motor vehicle on a road and fail to give your date of birth to a police constable
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person

(A)_[driving a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[whom a constable had reasonable cause to believe to have been the driver of a motor vehicle, **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), at a time when an accident occurred owing to its presence,]_
(C)_[whom a constable had reasonable cause to believe to have committed an offence in relation to the use of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_

on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), and who had been required by a constable to produce your

(D)_[licence,]_
(E)_[licence and its counterpart,]_

failed in prescribed circumstances, on being required by a constable, to state your date of birth
english.legislation: Contrary to section 164(6) of the Road Traffic Act 1988, regulation 26 of the Motor Vehicles (Driving Licences) Regulations 1987 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being person driving a motor vehicle OR
believed to have been driver when accident occurred OR
believed had committed an offence
relating to use of motor vehicle on a road
required to produce driving licence / counterpart
failed when required to state date of birth

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) The option 'licence and its counterpart' relates to licences which came into force on or after 1st June 1990 (1st January 1991 in the case of licences granted under the law of Northern Ireland). The "counterpart" details endorsements and provisional entitlements.
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant,

(A)_[having been the driver of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_
(B)_[who was suspected of being the driver of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) when an accident occurred owing to its presence]_
(C)_[who was suspected of committing an offence in relation to the use of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_

on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), failed to give

(D)_[his]_
(E)_[her]_

date of birth to a police constable when requested to do so.

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Gyrru cerbyd modur ar ffordd a methu rhoi eich dyddiad geni i gwnstabl
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording:
Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), a chithau'n unigolyn

(A)_[a oedd yn gyrru cerbyd modur, sef **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[yr oedd gan gwnstabl achos rhesymol dros gredu mai chi oedd yn gyrru cerbyd modur, **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), ar adeg pan ddigwyddodd damwain oherwydd ei bresenoldeb,]_
(C)_[yr oedd gan gwnstabl achos rhesymol dros gredu eich bod wedi cyflawni trosedd yng nghyswllt defnyddio cerbyd modur, sef **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_

ar ffordd, sef **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), ac y gofynnodd gwnstabl i chi gyflwyno eich

(D)_[trwydded,]_
(E)_[trwydded a'i gwrthran,]_

bu i chi fethu datgan eich dyddiad geni, mewn amgylchiadau penodol, pan ofynnodd gwnstabl i chi wneud hynny
welsh.welshstandardstatementoffacts:
Am **(..SPECIFY TIME..) ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) bu i'r diffynnydd,

(A)_[a oedd wedi gyrru **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_
(B)_[a oedd dan amheuaeth o fod yn gyrru **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) pan ddigwyddodd damwain oherwydd ei bresenoldeb]_
(C)_[a oedd dan amheuaeth o gyflawni trosedd yng nghyswllt defnyddio **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_

ar **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), fethu rhoi

(D)_[ei ddyddiad geni]_
(E)_[ei dyddiad geni]_

i gwnstabl pan ofynnwyd iddynt wneud hynny.
welsh.welshlegislation: Yn groes i adran 164(6) Deddf Traffig Ffyrdd 1988, rheoliad 26 Rheoliadau Cerbydau Modur (Trwyddedau Gyrru) 1987 ac Atodlen 2 Deddf Troseddwyr Traffig Ffyrdd 1988.
